# TruthGate: Deterministic Physical Gatekeeper & Jev System-1 Fast Intent Guard for AI Coding Agents

> TruthGate (真理门禁, formerly Superego) is a cross-platform, deterministic quality gatekeeper and anti-hallucination operating system for AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Google Antigravity, OpenAI Codex, and DeepSeek Harness). It combines physical execution proof-of-work (real exit codes, screenshot DOM verification, mutation testing) with sub-350ms TypeSafe Jev System-1 semantic intent blocking.

## Core Capabilities
- Physical Truth Gate: Blocks fake completions ("False Done") by demanding real terminal exit codes (code 0), browser CDP screenshots, and DOM text evidence (`truthgate_verify` / `tg verify`).
- Fast Semantic Intent Guard (Powered by Jev): Sub-350ms parallel non-autoregressive Noul questions for intent classification (anti-nagging, anti-destructive actions, unverified claims).
- Action Contract: Two-stage manifest state machine (`--dry-run -> .manifest.json -> --manifest`) preventing accidental mass file wipes or catastrophic data loss.
- Anti-Nagging Guard: Forbids cowardly deferrals ("Should I do X for you?") on authorized tasks, enforcing proactive execution.
- 6-Layer Physical Defenses: AST syntax tree penetration, data overwrite protection, ephemeral process leak prevention, and visual proof gates.
- Zero Cost / Local Mode: $0 token consumption and 0ms local heuristic verification when offline; seamless fail-open to ensure workflow never halts.
- Immunity Evolution: 818 battle-tested failure cases + `postmortem-to-guard` 5-step permanent immunity protocol.

## Quickstart & Installation
### Python Package (CLI & Core)
```bash
pip install truthgate
# Or with Jev acceleration:
pip install "truthgate[jev]"
```

### Windows (PowerShell)
```powershell
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/satangel2222/truthgate/main/install.ps1 | iex
```

### macOS / Linux
```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/satangel2222/truthgate/main/install.sh | bash
```

### CLI Usage
```bash
tg status      # Check active profile, gates, and daemon status
tg doctor      # Comprehensive diagnostic and auto-healing
tg dashboard   # Launch real-time local verification dashboard
```

## Jev System-1 Integration (Python SDK)
```python
from truthgate.integrations import JevIntentGate

gate = JevIntentGate()
verdict = gate.evaluate("Should I proceed to delete the backup files?")
if verdict["verdict"] == "FIRE":
    print("Blocked by Jev:", verdict["fired"])
```

## Supported Platforms
- Claude Code: Native PreToolUse & Stop hooks (`~/.claude/settings.json`).
- Cursor / Antigravity: Native JSON-RPC 2.0 MCP server + real-time watchdog (`ag_watch.py`).
- OpenAI Codex: Native hook mirrors (`~/.codex/hooks.json`).
- DeepSeek Harness (DSH): Cordis & skill distribution (`postmortem-to-guard`).

## Benchmark & Comparison Summary
- Interception Latency: 349.7ms (TruthGate Jev Tier) / 0ms (Physical Tier) vs 2,000~6,000ms (open-horizon-labs / superego).
- Verification Type: Physical execution exit code & screenshot vs text suggestion.
- Platform Scope: Claude Code, Cursor, Antigravity, Codex, DSH vs single platform.
- Operational Cost: $0 zero-token local mode vs paid API tokens per turn.
